messages:
arjun: Quick async — ops docket for GPU fleet.
arjun: What I did: validated us-west1 spot-fallback config, drained 2 noisy nodes, and ran warmup script for the dedicated pool.
arjun: Command I ran: `./bin/prewarm --region=us-west1 --pool=deds-1 --model=redwood-v2-small`
arjun: Blockers: GCP quota bump for us-central1 still pending (ticket #2456). Seeing higher-than-usual evictions in apac1 (spot).
arjun: Today: open an expedite with cloud-ops, reroute low-priority lanes to dedicated pool if quota doesn't land, and prep canary notes.

maria: thx. can you paste the exact grafana query for the eviction spike? planning to correlate with request rates.
maria: also quick ping — PR #4821 (batch-sizing tweak) is pending review, tests failing on the concurrency edge.

arjun: eviction query I use:
```
sum(rate(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{reason="Evicted"}[15m])) by (zone)
```
arjun: link: https://grafana.internal/d/abc123/gpu-evictions (scroll to apac1)

sam: I got an update from cloud-ops — quota request approved in principle, approvers queueing, ETA ~3h. I can temp-route low-priority traffic to us-central dedicated pool when ready.

lee: updated the autoscaler policy to bias toward deds-2 in us-central for low-priority lanes. Heads-up: expect a few cold-starts during the shift.
lee: Left an inline on PR #4821 — unit test needs a different fixture. @maria can you own that?

maria: I can take the test fix. Also suggest throttling warmup to avoid a billing spike: use `--concurrency=4` flag on prewarm.

infra-bot: [alert] Spot eviction rate in apac1 crossed 12% (15m window). Created internal incident incident-internal-381. Notifying oncall.

arjun: Ok switching plan: remove low-priority traffic from spot in apac1, kick prewarm with `--concurrency=4` in us-central when sam gives the go.
arjun: Updated ticket #2456 with link to incident and canary plan.

sam: will kick reroute once cloud-ops confirms. Pinged them for expedite.

maria: small heads-up — canary rollout scheduled 11:00 UTC. If quota lags, recommend delaying canary by 1h to avoid failure noise.

arjun: Ack. I'll update the canary runbook and add a delay option. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
